items.reason: A low-strength 2.5% rinse-off wash that suits oily-looking skin and the breakout look you want to clear up.
A fragrance-free ceramide moisturizer to keep skin comfortable, since benzoyl peroxide can leave skin feeling dry.

response.routine_note: Use the wash once a day in the evening at first, then moisturize, and build up only if your skin feels comfortable. Since you are trying for a baby, it is a good idea to check any product with your prenatal provider, and a dermatologist is the right person to ask if breakouts persist or become painful.
